text:
maya: Auditor wants a compact evidence bundle for the RBAC change (2026-03-18) that removed wildcard S3 write. Need PR, terraform plan, RoleBinding snapshot, CloudTrail entry showing deploy-bot apply, KMS Encrypt/GenerateDataKey events, and retention config (365d).

tom: I have the PR + commit hash, will export terraform plan to artifacts/rbac/3246/plan.txt and rolebinding YAML to artifacts/rolebindings/2026-03-18.yaml. PR: git.redwood/infra/ops/pulls/3266

auditor_claire: Also provide a short mapping doc tying each artifact to SOC2 CC6/CC7 and ISO A.9 entries. A one-paragraph narrative per control is fine.

sre_julian: CloudTrail snippets ready. Query showed userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName = "deploy-bot" and KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111:key/abcd-ef01 used for GenerateDataKey. I'll redact emails and include sample lines.

ops-bot: Evidence upload policy: put bundle under s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026-03-18/rbac-change/ with metadata evidence-type=rbac,collector=eng-security and include manifest.json + manifest.sha256 + manifest.sig.

maya: Plan: tom uploads artifacts, julian adds CloudTrail/KMS samples + retention screenshots, I'll draft mapping README and sign manifest with compliance key. Target EOD today. @auditor_claire please confirm timeframe.

auditor_claire: EOD ok. Please post presigned links (7d) when uploaded. Quick note: include instructions to verify PGP signature and key fingerprint in README.

maya: Will do. Thanks team.

tom: Uploading now, will post links when done.
